title: Weighted Interval Scheduling
statement:
Use predecessor search and dynamic programming to select a maximum-reward subset of nonoverlapping half-open screenings. The empty selection is allowed.

Input
n, then n lines start end reward. Endpoints that touch are compatible.

Output
Print the maximum total reward.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. −10⁹ ≤ start < end ≤ 10⁹. Rewards have absolute value at most 10⁹.
